claim: Every checked-in host microphone capture path acquires the same canonical authority before touching hardware, sends captured bytes through its ingress broker, and cannot revive the retired browser PCM bypasses.
implemented: Bounded sounddevice capture helpers reserve, meter, and release snapshot, focused, ambient, and calibration leases around the actual hardware call.
SensoryRuntime, ProactivePerceptionV2, SensoryIntegration, the listen skill, StableVoicePipeline, and macOS acoustic Reality Reach now use those helpers instead of opening sounddevice independently.
LocalVoiceCortex holds one persistent passive PyAudio lease, brokers every callback, closes its physical stream synchronously on preemption or revocation, and releases on every retry and stop path.
The obsolete aura.js half-duplex getUserMedia implementation was removed; the authenticated duplex surface is the only browser microphone owner.

The unauthenticated HTTP chunk route returns 410 after internal authentication, the legacy main-WebSocket byte lane returns a named retirement error, and the voice SSE route now requires internal authentication.
Runtime microphone disable queries and closes the actual duplex owner, while disabling ambient listening alone does not terminate a deliberate focused conversation.
An AST and client-source ratchet enumerates all direct capture APIs and fails if a new unfenced owner or retired transport returns.

focused_authority_and_routes.command: pytest -q tests/test_microphone_authority.py tests/test_local_voice_cortex_hardening.py tests/test_runtime_settings.py tests/test_owner_voice_conversation.py tests/test_device_voice_scope.py tests/test_macos_acoustic_reality.py tests/test_ambient_client_contract.py

static_integrity.result: Ruff touched-file checks, Python byte compilation, Node syntax, AST direct-capture ratchet, and git diff hygiene passed

remaining: Prove multilingual and noisy-room endpointing, barge-in, reconnect, default-device change, physical removal, and recovery on the rebuilt Aura.app.
Expose physical capture activity separately from lease ownership and retain authenticated session-scoped audio receipts through UI recovery.
Repair the campaign receipt schema, operation-specific code generation, semantic independence checks, and exact objective verification before rerunning the WOW battery.
